questions.solution_en:
106974
Number is divisible by 2 but not 4 as last two digits are not divisible by 4.

By division: 106974 = 7×15282+0 [number is divisible 7]

questions.q_en: A furniture manufacturer sells a dining table set to a showroom at a 20% discount on the marked price, but adds a 12% handling fee on the discounted price. questions.solution_en:
Let MP be x

Cost to showroom = x × 4/5 × 112/100

Showroom Profit = 25% of cost

5000 = 25% of cost

→cost = 20000

→20000 = x × 4/5 × 112/100

→x = ₹22,320
questions.solution_hi:
अंकित मूल्य (MP) मान लें = x

शो-रूम के लिए लागत = x × 4/5 × 112/100

शो-रूम का लाभ = लागत का 25%
₹5,000 = लागत का 25%
→ लागत = ₹20,000

→ 20,000 = x × 4/5 × 112/100
→ x = ₹22,320

questions.q_en: Two trains are moving in the same direction at the speed of 36 km/hr and 48 km/hr. The time taken by faster train to cross a man sitting in the slower train is 33 seconds. What will be the length of the faster train?
questions.q_hi: दो रेलगाड़ियाँ एक ही दिशा में 36 किमी/घंटा और 48 किमी/घंटा की गति से चल रही हैं। धीमी रेलगाड़ी में बैठे एक व्यक्ति को पार करने में तेज़ रेलगाड़ी को 33 सेकंड का समय लगता है। तेज़ रेलगाड़ी की लंबाई कितनी होगी?
options_en: 770 metres
90 metres
110 metres
180 metres
options_hi: 770 मीटर
90 मीटर
110 मीटर
180 मीटर
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed in same direction = 48 - 36 = 12 km/h
= 12 km/h × = 3.33 m/sec
Length of the faster train = 33 × 3.33 = 110m [approx]
questions.solution_hi:
समान दिशा में सापेक्ष गति = 48 - 36 = 12 किमी/घंटा
= 12 किमी/घंटा × = 3.33 मीटर/सेकंड
तेज़ गति वाली ट्रेन की लंबाई = 33 × 3.33 = 110 मीटर [लगभग]

Let M.P of 1 kg rice =1

And CP of 80 kg rice =80×90%= ₹72
free Rice get by him = =4kg
